simple.meaning: חֹם (chôm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “heat.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 15 times in Genesis, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, Nehemiah, Job, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 8:22. The surrounding contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹם (H2527) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חֹם (chôm) / H2527 is traced through Genesis 8:22, Genesis 18:1, 1 Samuel 11:9, 1 Samuel 11:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2527. chom חֹם noun masculine Jer 17:8 heat ; — חֹם absolute Gen 8:22 3 t. + 1Sam 21:7 (see below); construct Gen 18:1 + 3t.; of heat of (mid-) day היום חֹם 18:1 (J), 1Sam 11:11 ; 2Sam 4:5 ; in promise of regular seasons Gen 8:22 (opposed to קֹר ); compare Isa 18:4 (twice in verse) ( ׳ח קָצִיר ); but as dangerous to plant-life Jer 17:8 ; it melts snow Job 24:19 ; חֹם לֶחֶם 1Sam 21:7 bread of heat = hot bread , read perhaps ׳ל חָם (as Josh 9:12 ).
